units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 9:7">Sabb. IX, 7</cite> <he>ח׳ חי טהור</he> a living clean (eatable) locust.—Pl. <he>חֲגָבִים</he>, <he>חֲגָבין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:5">Pes. III, 5</cite> (spreading apart) <he>כקרני ח׳</he> like the proboscides of locusts.
<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:9">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:5">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:5">XIII</cite>), 5.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:8">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> the palm-trees appeared to them <he>כאלו ח׳</he> as though they were locusts (v. <cite ref="H00146"><he>חֲגָזָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shabbat 152a">Sabb. 152ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00078"><he>עֲגָבָה</he></cite>. V. also <cite ref="S02114"><he>קַרְסוֹל</he></cite>.
